entries.text: - **RST-01:** band-limited POCS is the best of the local lightweight methods. The established next comparison is a constrained sparse declipper such as SPADE or social sparsity. The authors’ open MATLAB toolbox evaluates many sparse/constrained methods, but requires MATLAB, LTFAT and (for C-OMP) CVX, so it was not runnable in the current Python pilot. [Declipping survey, code and data](https://rajmic.github.io/declipping2020/), [author repository](https://github.com/rajmic/declipping2020_codes).
